definitions.participation_denominator: Only confirmed offensive participation/opportunities; not all roster/active games; last5/3 are team games, not last appearances
definitions.qb_pressure: Unavailable; qb_hit and sacks are separate observed proxies, never pressure rate
definitions.redzone: STANDARD targets/carries at yardline<=20; goal-line carries<=5
definitions.classification: FAVORAVEL iff eligible n>=5 and observed hits/n>=.7 with no explicit regime/role/last3<50% guard; descriptive threshold rubric, not statistical significance, forecast or financial authorization
